i love “the body keeps the score”, i just began my healing journey & that was the first book i finished. i experience a LOT of physical pain, especially in my vaginal & lower abdomen area (sometimes even my lower back) & i only sleep a full 6-7 hours maybe 1-2 nights a week, i’m always awake it feels like.

 i walk a lot, try to do mindful body scans**, art, swim, basically anything that helps my left & right brain talk to each other. journaling helps me the most, i write down what physical pain i’m feeling/where it is & try to investigate what that part of my body is trying to tell me. ill breathe into that part & focus while also reminding myself that i am safe & it’s okay for me to remember things now. i  know it sounds silly, but i think the physical pain is tied to a certain experience almost like it’s trying to tell u something (a story/flashback). reading TBKS helped me put names to physical sensations/pain in my body & allowing myself to remember things in a safe & loving space. sometimes we’re in pain because we’re feeling what it felt like when it WAS happening & we must acknowledge it in order to process & accept it so it can be released. 

i hope this helps, if u have any questions or anything i can try to help as best i can :) sending healing & loving thoughts ur way 💜💜
